BuildGenie Toolkit APKs, built by .github/workflows/build-guide-toolkit-apk.yml.

guide_toolkit-debug.apk    debug build (applicationId com.buildgenie.toolkit.debug)
guide_toolkit-release.apk  release build signed with the debug keystore (sideload-ready)

This tag is force-updated on every build, so it always holds the newest APKs.
Install with:  adb install -r guide_toolkit-release.apk
